items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: Fred Astaire was going then, you know, and Ray Bolger and Tom Patricola and James Bodden and Jack Donahue and the Misconi Brothers. They were dancing then

ctx.x: In other words, tap-dances weren't the main act?

No. Fred Astaire was going then, you know, and Ray Bolger and Tom Patricola and James Bodden and Jack Donahue and the Misconi Brothers. They were dancing then, but the idea was that I just put the dancing in my mind from my voice cracking and I thought I'd start dancing by myself.
These original Pathe' films that you made though, they were just you and Buck singing and playing the piano.
